runs.latest_final: The daughter died naturally and was buried uncremated. Because the newly settled village had no means to cremate its dead, other villagers’ uncremated relatives were already buried in forest bears could reach. A bear dug up the daughter’s grave and scavenged her body; her father found it and shot it. He feared that other bears could independently find and eat the other buried bodies too. The danger was to the dead, not to living people, and killing this bear would not protect the other graves.
